title: Captain Viriato's radar track at Mach 15

tellings.quote: And uh Captain Virat recorded this thing on radar and it was he recorded at Mach 15 doing a zigzag pattern.

plain: In Brazil in 1986, an officer Michels calls Captain Viriato is said to have caught an object on radar moving at Mach 15, about fifteen times the speed of sound, in a zigzag pattern. Michels tells it himself, in an episode on Brazilian cases, without naming a source beyond the captain. No known aircraft could fly like that.
